response.overview: To prove that no crime is too small to escape justice, a government sets out to turn the hunt for one ordinary man into a national propaganda story. Cameras are ready, plans are made, and every moment is prepared for the screen. But the bigger the operation gets, the harder it is to hide, and the man they’re chasing starts to notice.
response.tagline: They planned the perfect story. He saw it coming.
response.title: Every Angle
